decisions.statement: Every build runs on the single mac this workstation reaches over ssh.
A change to how an app is built is proved by `akasha deploy <app> --simulator`.
That run needs no phone, no signing and no App Store Connect.
An agent at this workstation runs it rather than asking Alan to run it.
A TestFlight build is made by an agent at this workstation rather than by Alan.
How many commits a build carries is no reason to put that build to Alan.
A simulator run is delivered a few folders rather than a checkout.
The sources a program compiles are read off that program's `ios-program` page.
The sources a TestFlight build was made from are remembered outside akasha.
An app on a phone is the build the last install put there.
The build on a phone can disagree with the build the server is already sending.
An install has every change already on main rather than the change that asked for the install.
Nothing outside an app's page states a value that page has.

definition: the iOS work this workstation drives on a mac it reaches over ssh
